title: Kenyan Beef Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic beef stew inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made with tender beef, caramelized onions, and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 pounds boneless beef shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside. Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the sliced onions until caramelized.
Add the kisumu style spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil. Return the beef to the pot and cover.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped cilantro.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
